scope: Every unique governed job opportunity represented in evals/hiring-readers/current.json requires one distinct dated resume and an exact-resume assessment from each named reader assigned to that opportunity.
acceptanceQuestion: I would advance this candidate to an interview for this job based on this resume.

primarySkill.installedLocation: global user skill store; local path intentionally not committed
practicesApplied: product and business evidence in bullets
clear standard language with actual titles preserved

localOverrides: A target-role headline may never replace or rename an actual employment title.
Only governed metrics and outcomes may appear; missing metrics remain gaps rather than invented numbers.
Collective work retains collaborator credit and bounded causation.
Named readers are fictionalized public-context lenses, not participation, quotations, endorsements, or real hiring decisions.
Resume screening answers whether to advance to interview; it does not claim that a resume alone proves a final hire decision.

humanReviewGates: Jamie approves each exact resume before application submission.
Employers retain eligibility, interview, and hiring authority.
A real named person has not reviewed a resume unless a separately verified real review is recorded.

opportunities.targetRole: Senior Project Manager, Learning and Project Solutions

biasChecks: Do not penalize independent or civic work merely because it did not occur inside a large enterprise.

readerAssessments.name: Terence Dougherty
